name: Darzi Desk
summary: A tailor shop desk: measurements per customer, orders, Eid rush calendar, karigars and payments
about: A complete order desk for a gents tailoring shop, in PKR. It keeps kameez, shalwar and waistcoat measurements for every customer, books orders with fabric and design notes, warns about the Eid rush and busy days, and tracks advances, balances and karigar wages. Good for a darzi shop, a boutique or anyone who stitches to order.
how: Watch the tape measure unroll across the Overview, then switch the chart between 7D, 30D and 12M to see the lines reshape.
Press New order: pick a customer, garment and delivery date. A note warns you when the date falls in the Eid rush or on a day that is already full.
Open a customer to see the kameez figure draw itself; focus a measurement box and its line lights up on the figure.
On the Calendar, drag an order chip onto another day to move its delivery, or use the calendar button in the day panel.
On Karigars, drag order cards between tailors (or use the move button) and pay weekly wages.
Open any order to move it through Cutting, Stitching, Finishing and Ready, take payments and print a slip.
